title: anamnesis-engagement/v1
description: One audit engagement and the rounds it ran. An engagement groups rounds; it does not adjudicate findings and carries no verdict of its own.

source.description: The admitted source these rounds were read from.

label.description: The round heading exactly as the source wrote it.

date.description: The date as the source wrote it, unparsed. Sources differ in format and normalising here would lose what was written.

findings.description: Count of findings this round recorded. Zero is a real value and is not missing.

native_schema.description: The audit schema the round declared, or unknown when it declared none. Legacy rounds predate the field; unknown is not none.

verdict.description: The Elenchus verdict the round recorded, or unknown when it recorded none.
